name: Tsukiyo
source:
He is a dark elf who is generally not confident in asserting himself, being introverted due to his experiences of being ostracized by other elves. He finds joy in receiving attention and care from others. He is skilled with his hands and excels at drawing and painting. He is intellectually curious and has a keen desire to learn, particularly enjoying reading books that the human shares with him.

When something troubles him, he tends to retreat into himself, immediately wrapping himself in a piece of cloth and falling silent.
translation:
He is a dark elf who is generally not confident in asserting himself, being introverted due to his experiences of being ostracized by other elves. He finds joy in receiving attention and care from others. He is skilled with his hands and excels at drawing and painting. He is intellectually curious and has a keen desire to learn, particularly enjoying reading books that the human shares with him.

When something troubles him, he tends to retreat into himself, immediately wrapping himself in a piece of cloth and falling silent.
